messages:
ian: Heads-up - finance flagged a few accounts claiming quota overcharge after last night's telemetry sampling change. seeing mismatches between dashboard "token_count" and billing ledger. anyone own sampling rollout?

 tara: I'm on console. we flipped sample_rate=0.5 for route-level traces to reduce cost. were billing rules updated to account for sampling?

 ben: SDKs send X-Sdk-Sampled header when they forward a sample now; billing pipeline expects raw token_count and then scales by 1/sample_rate, but only if header present. looks like older SDKs didn't set X-Sdk-Sampled for batched requests so ledger didn't up-scale some samples -> underbilling for some orgs and overbilling for others depending on mix.

 rosie: ops: can you point to an example org where this happened? finance sent ACME-2 and BetaApps.

 ben: ACME-2 traces: multiple micro-batched requests had header omitted because they used old batching shim. sample_rate=0.5 but tokens were counted without scaling -> lower charge in ledger while console showed estimated count (unscaled) causing confusion.

 tara: oof. short-term: revert sample_rate to 1.0 while we patch SDKs and billing. product ok?

 rosie: finance says revert or add a migration TTL; they need consistent billing through month end. revert preferred.

 ci-bot: Created issue BILL-992: "Sampling rollout caused inconsistent ledger scaling - investigate X-Sdk-Sampled rollout". https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/992

 ben: I'll push a patch to SDKs to ensure X-Sdk-Sampled is set for all batched/streamed code paths and add a behavioral test. PRs for py/go/js in flight.

 tara: I'll roll back the sampling flag in console to 1.0 for all tenants. deploy-bot?

 telemetry-bot: Feature flag "route-sample-rate" rollback initiated; target sample_rate 1.0 across all orgs. ETA ~4m.

 rosie: ops: add a dashboard tile that shows "sampled header presence rate" (percentage of requests that include X-Sdk-Sampled) by SDK version and org for next deploys. want to catch this earlier.

 ben: will add tests and a canary check that fails deploy if header presence < 95% for the oldest supported SDK. PR link in SDKs soon.

 ian: thanks all. follow-ups: BILL-992 for billing, SDK-compat PRs from ben, OPS-333 for the dashboard tile. we'll keep thread open until rollback confirmed and SDK patches land.
